_comment: Test material, memory designs, and evaluation rules, frozen before any system code was written. help_center.json and prompt.json are byte-identical copies of 02-agentic-workflows/data (same SHA-256 as its FROZEN.json). account.json is 02's account.json with one added line: payment PAY-5008, the refund of the duplicate charge (diff the two files to check). python/run.py checks these hashes before every run and records them in the results.
